summary: Sends a reply back when it reports a traffic, reach, or engagement number without a sample size, time window, and spread.
doc: This Stop hook blocks a reply that states a headline audience number, such as visitors, views, followers, clicks, sessions, an average, or a multiple, in a traffic or platform context without stating the sample size, time window, and spread. Spread means a median, a per-person ratio, or a breakdown. A ranking across two or more platforms must name the platforms that report the metric. A total can be correct while its meaning is false. One outlier can carry a mean, one week can carry a sixty-day total, and one view per visitor with no returns often means a crawler. The hook ignores numbers inside fenced code blocks. When a number does not need a breakdown, npx guardhooks declare aggregate-composition-stop "<reason>" disables the hook for two hours.
